message.zcinema.not_flat: That is not a flat wall of black concrete
gui.zcinema.hint: Build a black concrete wall, then sneak + right-click it with a stick to register the screen.
gui.zcinema.status.idle: Paste an MP4 direct link and press Load
gui.zcinema.status.waiting: Waiting for another viewer to catch up
gui.zcinema.status.error: Failed to open the stream (check the URL)
zcinema.configuration.sync.syncIntervalT: How often the server broadcasts the full playback state to viewers.
zcinema.configuration.sync.globalStallPa: Pause everyone when one viewer stalls
When one client stalls (network hiccup), pause the clock for everyone until it recovers.
zcinema.configuration.stream.maxFrameWid: Frames wider than this are downscaled while decoding (saves bandwidth/CPU).
zcinema.configuration.stream.maxFrameHei: Frames taller than this are downscaled while decoding.
zcinema.configuration.stream.bufferSecon: How far ahead of the shared clock this client decodes.
zcinema.configuration.stream.fpsCap.tool: Frame rate used to size the decode buffer.
zcinema.configuration.sync.hardResyncSec: If the shared clock and local playback diverge by more than this, reopen the stream.
If this client runs out of buffered video for this long it tells the server, which pauses everyone until it recovers.
zcinema.configuration.audio.audioDistanc: How far away the screen audio can be heard.
